text:
alex: Midnight poll  what's your go-to editor + late-night snack combo when chasing a bug? Reply with the number or add your wild card. Options: 1) Nano + instant noodles 2) VSCode + cold pizza 3) Neovim + hummus & pita 4) JetBrains + granola bar 5) Tea only (no editor)
rina: 3) Neovim + hummus & pita. Chewy pita = focus. :ramen: :sparkles:
ty: 2) VSCode + cold pizza. Reheat is for quitters. :pizza:
harry: 5) Tea only. I'll just watch you all suffer. :tea:
ops-bot: Poll created. React with 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣ 4️⃣ 5️⃣ to vote.
alex: quick manual tally so far:
```
1: (none)
2: ty
3: rina
4: (none)
5: harry
```
rina: also, important note: hummus near keyboards requires a dedicated napkin protocol. :warning:
ty: @rina agreed. but cold pizza is easier to eat one-handed while debugging. :grin:
ahlex: will post final tally at 6pm PST and suggest a sticker idea for the winner: "Midnight Debug Fuel" pack. Any objections?
harry: No objections. Also someone bring extra napkins. :raised_hand_with_fingers_splayed:
